items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: And we started a little band called Crescent City High Hatters. That was Maurice and Joyce, Justin and Harold Antwine, Andrew, Alexis, James Leysen.

ctx.x: How long did you stick with drums?

Oh, not too very long. Yeah, I started to tell you. I started going- And the gang of the neighborhood started telling me about the school, so I got interested. And it was a good place to go in the evening after school, I mean, to keep you out of mischief. So I started going around. And I started taking, I had a little printing under this teacher there. Oh, I can't think of now. And then I was taking up Coventry. And then I started going and listening to the band. Well, they had enough fellow youngsters there to…
What did they play, those different guys?
